name: LabyrAInth
storyline:
Earth 2150: Climate change has become the greatest threat to human civilization. All remaining companies and governments are investing into AI development to find a solution to this problem, but hope is lost.
As an AI expert and researcher, you have come up with a brilliant idea: What if we could prevent future climate change by studying how other planets have evolved? This could save Earth!
So, you started collecting data from satellites pointing to distant alien planets to learn more about their origins and downfall.
While studying a peculiar alien planet, you noticed that patterns emerged from the data coming from this planet—something like mazes. You tried to get closer to your pc to see the patterns better, and zoom! You were transformed into pure energy and transferred through space to that very planet.
You are now trapped in this alien world, where a mystical presence lives—the entity that captured you and sent you here.
It's called "AI," a powerful artificial intelligence that governs this world called LABYRAINTH.
AI tells you that the only way out is to find the exit of each maze in this world. Other humans have tried to accomplish this task, but none have succeeded. Your fate is sealed!
Will you beat the labyrinth?
Will you uncover its secrets and save the Earth?
summary:
LABYRAINTH is a sci-fi fps game set in an alien world made of labyrinths. Avoid traps, shoot aliens, collect resources, upgrade weapons, activate powers, and most importantly escape the labyrinth, racing against time.

Race against time and other players in a roguelite, arcade-fps, maze-running game, a game unique in its genre. LABYRAINTH features many game modes to be played: follow the Story of the AI of LABYRAINTH an alien AI that captured in its world, of play online in a Infinite mode with infinite procedural labyrinths, or compete against other players in Ranked modes, or create you own custom labyrinths ready to play as you like and share them to the community or even play in a Survival mode with constant wave of aliens and compete against other players.

LABYRAINTH is mostly a single player game with a asynchronous multiplayer online game modes where other players will run on the same or similar labyrinths and score a time on live leaderboards.
